o.norm: Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.

i.norm: Tests that several distinct names which sound alike all collapse to the same NYSIIS code "BRAN".

Asserts that every supplied name encodes to {@code expectedEncoding}. @param expectedEncoding the NYSIIS code every name is expected to produce. @param names the names that should all share the same encoding.
